metadata.title: AI Video Studio Workspace
metadata.description: A focused production workspace for drafting, organizing, and iterating AI video clips in Happy Horse AI.

header.title: AI Video Studio
header.description: Use one focused studio to draft shots, scan inspiration, and review your latest renders without leaving the page.
header.note: Homepage handoff, prompt submission, media upload, polling, and task lists are live. Inspiration remains mock data in this release.
